company.name: Dashlane
company.shortDescription: Dashlane is a leading credential manager that removes complexity by pairing comprehensive security with ease of use.
company.description: Dashlane is a leading credential manager that removes complexity by pairing comprehensive security with ease of use. We are closely attuned to the needs of our users, balancing simple tools with an uncompromising approach to security–a game changer for anyone, but especially for IT admins working to secure their organization. Our team in Paris, New York, and Lisbon is united by a strong sense of community and passion for improving the digital experience. Over 22,000 businesses and 19M users globally use Dashlane for a faster, simpler, and more secure internet.

productsAndServices.description: A credential security platform that combines password management with browser-based credential risk detection, employee alerts, remediation, and visibility into logins outside SSO.
productsAndServices.name: Dashlane Omnix™ platform

productsAndServices.description: A browser-based credential security product that detects password risks and phishing threats, then provides real-time employee alerts and remediation even when employees do not use a Dashlane vault.
productsAndServices.name: Dashlane Credential Protection

productsAndServices.description: An enterprise password manager that provides encrypted employee vaults, secure credential sharing, passkey storage, and centralized administrative controls for access, policies, reporting, and provisioning.
productsAndServices.name: Dashlane Business Password Management

productsAndServices.description: A password manager for individuals that stores and autofills passwords, passkeys, payment information, and other personal credentials across computers and mobile devices.
productsAndServices.name: Dashlane Personal Password Manager

productsAndServices.description: A password management plan for households that helps family members store, autofill, share, and manage passwords and other credentials across their devices.
productsAndServices.name: Dashlane Family Password Manager

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series D round raised $110,000,000, or 52.16% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $15,436,614 to $802,101,752, a 51.96x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
